import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    btcAmount = int(next(it))
    btcCosts = [0] * 100
    even = 0
    odd = 0
    right = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if right == 0:
            left = int(next(it))
        else:
            left = right
            right = 0
        if left % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
        if even == odd and i != n - 1:
            right = int(next(it))
            btcCost = abs(left - right)
            btcCosts[btcCost] += 1
            even = 0
            odd = 0
    sawedAmount = 0
    currentBTCCost = 0
    for i in range(100):
        for j in range(btcCosts[i]):
            currentBTCCost += i
            if currentBTCCost <= btcAmount:
                sawedAmount += 1
            else:
                break
    print(sawedAmount)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
